mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast conditions at Fireman's Park with a temperature of 75 degrees. Expect an overnight low of 68 degrees with rain moving in overnight. Under the Waning Gibbous moon, we have an ISS pass at 3:29 AM, moving from the northwest over Verona High School toward the northeast near Home Depot, staying low on the horizon.

September 2026 is officially Hunger Action Month in Verona. Mayor Luke Diaz is encouraging residents to volunteer and donate, noting that 1 in 8 residents in Southwest Wisconsin faces food insecurity, and this proclamation supports nutrition security for our community.

There is plenty to do today, including the Verona Area Kids Triathlon, Girls Try Hockey at the Verona Ice Arena, and live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, we have Yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow.

During the week of August 17, officers handled various calls. Notably, on August 21, an officer conducted a traffic stop for expired registration and cited a driver for possession of marijuana after detecting an odor coming from the vehicle.
Today's flavor of the day is Georgia Peach. The store is open and serving guests until 10:00 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for your favorite treat.
